cases.name: Far Wanderings
cases.text:
Search your library for a basic land card, put that card onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
If there are seven or more cards in your graveyard, instead search your library for up to three basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

cases.name: Kamahl's Sledge
cases.text:
Kamahl's Sledge deals 4 damage to target creature.
If there are seven or more cards in your graveyard, instead Kamahl's Sledge deals 4 damage to that creature and 4 damage to that creature's controller.

cases.name: Rancid Earth
cases.text:
Destroy target land.
If there are seven or more cards in your graveyard, instead destroy that land and Rancid Earth deals 1 damage to each creature and each player.

cases.name: Toxic Stench
cases.text:
Target nonblack creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
If there are seven or more cards in your graveyard, instead destroy that creature. It can't be regenerated.

cases.name: Traverse the Ulvenwald
cases.text:
Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
If there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, instead search your library for a creature or land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

cases.name: Winds of Qal Sisma
cases.text:
Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn.
If you control a creature with power 4 or greater, instead prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn by creatures your opponents control.

cases.name: Unrelated Example
cases.text:
Destroy target land.
If there are seven or more cards in your graveyard, instead.

cases.name: Kamahl's Sledge
cases.text:
Kamahl's Sledge deals 5 damage to target creature.
If there are seven or more cards in your graveyard, instead Kamahl's Sledge deals 4 damage to that creature and 4 damage to that creature's controller.

cases.name: Rancid Earth
cases.text:
Destroy target land.
If there are seven or more cards in your graveyard, instead destroy that land and Rancid Earth deals 2 damage to each creature and each player.
